iti91:2.2: abhilāpāyaṃ bhikkhave lokasmiṃ piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇīti.
iti91:2.3: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā atthavasaṃ paṭicca
iti91:2.4: neva rājābhinītā na corābhinītā na iṇaṭṭā na bhayaṭṭā ājīvikā pakatā
iti91:2.5: api ca kho otiṇṇamhā jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi duk khotiṇṇā dukkhaparetā
iti91:2.6: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti.
iti91:2.8: hoti abhijjhālu kāmesu tibbasārāgo byāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo.
iti91:2.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave chavālātaṃ ubhato padittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ neva gāme kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharati na araññe
iti91:2.10: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno sāmaññatthañca na paripūretīti.
